title: Hierarchy-boosted funnel learning for identifying semiconductors with ultralow lattice thermal conductivity
research_summary: The paper proposes a hierarchy-boosted funnel learning (HiBoFL) framework that integrates unsupervised and supervised learning to efficiently identify semiconductors with ultralow lattice thermal conductivity (κL), circumventing large-scale brute-force ab initio calculations. It uses unsupervised clustering on descriptors to narrow the search space, performs low-cost high-throughput calculations (HTC) on selected clusters to build a labeled local database, trains a CatBoost classifier for direct prediction, and conducts interpretable analysis to uncover structure-property relationships—particularly a new descriptor Lmin governing structural anharmonicity.

title: An efficient forgetting-aware fine-tuning framework for pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
file_name: 41_An efficient forgetting-aware fine-tuning framework for pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials.pdf
research_summary: Pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have revolutionized computational materials science by enabling rapid atomistic simulations as efficient alternatives to ab initio methods. Fine-tuning pretrained MLIPs offers a practical approach to improving accuracy for materials and properties where predictive performance is insufficient. However, this approach often induces catastrophic forgetting, undermining the generalizability that is a key advantage of pretrained MLIPs. Herein, we propose reEWC, an advanced fine-tuning strategy that integrates Experience Replay and Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) to effectively balance forgetting prevention with fine-tuning efficiency.
